subject: My Perspective
author: Jinno Angelo
body:
Me personally, I like Burnout and I hate Burnout...

I like how you could go past 340 and get max speed on jumps and the constant challenge of getting even faster... But I also hate those last minute crashes, the unfair handicap while in 6th place, and the slowness of other racers at times...

IMO, I hate Paradise the most and all the first time players who adore it so much... I certainly hate ALL the Revenge players too because theyre all competition except for the 10% who are just great at game, fast, are fun to talk to and make the best of every set.. And I definitely hate those people who are sitting on the track slowing everyone else down and most definitely the very angry ones too...

However if you have a last name that ends in a TRON or a VW in the first part of your name, theres kudos and Moosetracks ice cream for you...... Everyone else gets kudos and Chocolate Chip Ice cream.... 

 

------------------------------------

"I Have Loved. I Have Suffered. Now, I Hate."

subject: Not why I wrote it..
author: ZombieTron
body: I wanted to do this blog for a while, and I don't think it is sucking up to anyone, if anything it shows that everything I love most about Burnout is not what Paradise is about. I hope Alex doesn't get upset by it! 🙂

subject: Tough Love!
author: Jinno Angelo
body:
We know you Love Burnout Zombs.... I dont think you should have to write this post to suck up to Alex because of his comment... Do you feel that obligated to? As far as I know you have done nothing wrong and you have stood out to either positive or negatively critique Paradise, but its all for the greater good because EVERY opinion should matter... So why should you start sucking up to him and start getting on his good side when youve been loyal to the series all along????

---------------------------

"I Have Loved. I Have Suffered. Now, I Hate."
